statement: xpadneo's probe marks the link as HOGP only when the HID bus is Bluetooth and the supplied HID version is at least 0x0500, with an explicit warning for a known anomalous version. A Bluetooth-bus UHID device carrying a different version can therefore select a different output route even if VID/PID and report descriptor match. This is a driver heuristic, not proof of a device's true firmware version.
